name: proof-repair
description: Generate self-consistent repair plans for mathematical proof issues found by /proofcheck, with literature-backed support. For each problematic assumption, model, proposition, or theorem, proposes fixes that preserve the full dependency chain and searches arXiv, Semantic Scholar, and Google Scholar for new references to support repairs. Use when user says "repair proofs", "fix proof issues", "修复证明", "proof repair", "修正计划", "fix theorem", "repair assumptions", or wants to go from proof audit to actionable repair plan with literature support.
